posts.alt: Mediterranean Rancho Santa Fe outdoor kitchen with stainless grill, wood-fired pizza oven and louvered pergola at a Spanish estate at golden hour
posts.hook: Why a real outdoor kitchen outlives the trend.
posts.caption:
An outdoor kitchen lives outside 365 days a year — salt air, sun, heat off the grill. Build it like a patio set and it looks tired in two summers. Build it right and it ages like the house.

That means marine-grade stainless cabinetry, full-thickness stone, and a grill and pizza oven sized for real cooking — not a showpiece.

The selections:
• DCS built-in grill
• Danver stainless cabinetry
• Arizona Tile travertine countertops
• Eldorado Stone veneer
• wood-fired pizza oven
• StruXure louvered pergola

Want one specced for how you actually cook and host? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Sunken desert-modern fire lounge in Mount Helix with circular fire pit, seat walls and agave on a hillside with mountain views at dusk
posts.hook: A sunken fire lounge looks effortless. Here's what's under it.
posts.caption:
A sunken lounge reads simple — drop the seating, light the fire, done. The part you don't see is what makes it last.

On a hillside like this it starts with grading and drainage so the pad never shifts, then engineered seat walls, a gas line run to code, and a burner rated for the wind that rolls off the valley at night. Get those right and it's still solid in ten years.

The selections:
• Warming Trends CrossFire fire pit
• Techo-Bloc Aberdeen seat walls
• Bedrosians travertine caps
• Kichler landscape lighting
• agave & barrel cactus

Building on a slope? That's our favorite kind of problem. DM “DESIGN”.

Got the space and the itch? DM “DESIGN” and we'll lay it out.

posts.alt: Compact South Park urban courtyard with louvered pergola, linear fire feature, herringbone pavers and potted citrus at dusk
posts.caption:
It's a narrow strip between two walls in South Park. It's also where the whole evening ends up — fire on, citrus in the pots, the city somewhere past the roofline.

A small yard isn't a compromise here. It's an invitation to make every square foot earn its place.

The selections:
• Belgard Urbana pavers (herringbone)
• StruXure louvered pergola
• HPC Fire linear feature
• FX Luminaire lighting
• potted citrus & bougainvillea

Working with a compact lot? That's where good design earns its keep. DM “DESIGN”.
